name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.15.8 presents the strongest selected-product Coupon first with its benefit, customer requirement, included products, exclusions, and estimated price when supported, then lists every other current offer in a separate section. Checkout remains the authority for eligibility and stacking. Independently verified Awin merchant-brand evidence remains available during exact matching, restoring Nextrition Pet food recall without weakening unrelated-merchant filtering. Short branded product identities such as Nike Dunk, bounded Catalog-description evidence, and separate memory or storage constraints remain supported. Reviewed Awin merchants remain eligible for trusted exact-and-similar matches, while qualifying Shopify results are labeled as high-rated Shopify merchants. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Railway serves reviewed official storefronts and trusted merchants from schema-valid immutable releases; invalid or unavailable database snapshots cannot replace the last valid registry. Official cards require an approved exact domain, verified product identity, a valid public USD price, and stable product identity; unsupported or blocked sites fail closed and may use user-authorized Chrome only as a fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. Text search treats a maximum budget as a ceiling and never recommends products absent from returned cards. Exact selected-product follow-ups reuse stable selection identity. Price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting remain disabled. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Call the matching tool. Reply only in request language. No Memory, repo, logs, task, cache, plan, or manual MCP launch.
